dialogues.jp: 「ふぅ」
dialogues.en: "Phew."
dialogues.text: "Phew."

dialogues.jp:
部屋で着替えて、飲み物でもと居間に下りると、
音夢が机の上で勉強をしていた。
dialogues.en:
I found Nemu studying at the table after I changed in my
room and came downstairs to get something to drink.
dialogues.text:
I found Nemu studying at the table after I changed in my
room and came downstairs to get something to drink.

dialogues.jp: 「お前、なんでわざわざ下で勉強してるんだ？」
dialogues.en: "Why are you studying downstairs?"
dialogues.text: "Why are you studying downstairs?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.en: "What?"
dialogues.text: "What?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「自分の部屋のほうが集中できるだろうが」
dialogues.en: "Can't you concentrate better in your own room?"
dialogues.text: "Can't you concentrate better in your own room?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「えと……まぁ、そうなんだけど」
dialogues.en: "Yeah...... that's true, but..."
dialogues.text: "Yeah...... that's true, but..."

dialogues.jp:
と、音夢の手がさりげなくテレビのリモコンを
隠すように動く。
dialogues.en:
Her hand casually moved to hide the remote control for the
TV.
dialogues.text:
Her hand casually moved to hide the remote control for the
TV.

dialogues.jp: 「ドラマか……」
dialogues.en: "That show again?"
dialogues.text: "That show again?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「あ、なにその悟りきったような口調は！？」
dialogues.en:
"What's that attitude? You're acting like you know
everything."
dialogues.text:
"What's that attitude? You're acting like you know
everything."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「はずれか？」
dialogues.en: "Am I wrong?"
dialogues.text: "Am I wrong?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「う……当たりだけどさぁ」
dialogues.en: "Mm...... you're right."
dialogues.text: "Mm...... you're right."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「そんなに気になるなら見ちゃえばいいのに。
　そのほうがよっぽど集中できるだろう」
dialogues.en:
"Why don't you just watch it? Can't you concentrate better
that way?"
dialogues.text:
"Why don't you just watch it? Can't you concentrate better
that way?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「そうなんだけど。こう、それをやると最後の
　一線を超えちゃうような気がして」
dialogues.en:
"I know what you're saying, but I'm afraid I'll be crossing
the line if I did that."
dialogues.text:
"I know what you're saying, but I'm afraid I'll be crossing
the line if I did that."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「表現はおかしいが言いたいことは分かる」
dialogues.en:
"That's a weird explanation, but I think I know what you're
saying."
dialogues.text:
"That's a weird explanation, but I think I know what you're
saying."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「後、部屋だとマンガが読みたくなったり、な
　んだか掃除をしたくなっちゃって」
dialogues.en:
"Also, if I stay in my room, I feel like cleaning up the
room or start reading some manga."
dialogues.text:
"Also, if I stay in my room, I feel like cleaning up the
room or start reading some manga."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「あぁ」
dialogues.en: "I see."
dialogues.text: "I see."

dialogues.jp:
時折、音夢の部屋が模様替えしていることがあっ
たが、丁度前後にテストがあったのか。
dialogues.en:
I remember she was changing her room around, but was it
before the test?
dialogues.text:
I remember she was changing her room around, but was it
before the test?

dialogues.jp: 「ま、張り詰めすぎると身体に悪いぞ」
dialogues.en: "Well, don't study too hard."
dialogues.text: "Well, don't study too hard."

dialogues.jp: ココアをふたり分いれて、机の上に置く。
dialogues.en: I made two cups of hot cocoa and put them on the table.
dialogues.text: I made two cups of hot cocoa and put them on the table.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「うわぁ、ありがと♪」
dialogues.en: "Wow, thank you!"
dialogues.text: "Wow, thank you!"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「別にいいさ」
dialogues.en: "Don't mention it."
dialogues.text: "Don't mention it."

dialogues.jp:
テレビでも見ようと思ったが、音夢の邪魔にな
りそうで、なにもせずにソファーに座る。
dialogues.en:
I wanted to watch TV, but I didn't want to bother Nemu, so I
just sat on the sofa.
dialogues.text:
I wanted to watch TV, but I didn't want to bother Nemu, so I
just sat on the sofa.

dialogues.jp:
ぼう、と音夢が教科書とノートを手繰る音と、
鉛筆が走る音を聞く。
dialogues.en:
I listened to the sound of her textbook pages turning and
her pencil running on the notebook.
dialogues.text:
I listened to the sound of her textbook pages turning and
her pencil running on the notebook.

dialogues.jp:
「テスト期間中は、なんだか色々とやりたくな
　るからな」
dialogues.en: "The exam week makes you want to do other stuff, you know?"
dialogues.text: "The exam week makes you want to do other stuff, you know?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「甘いもの欲しくなったり、急に思い出したよ
　うに買い物したくなるよね」
dialogues.en:
"Like you crave for some sweet stuff, or you get an impulse
to go shopping."
dialogues.text:
"Like you crave for some sweet stuff, or you get an impulse
to go shopping."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「結局は欲求不満なんだろうけどな」
dialogues.en: "It's probably because of frustration."
dialogues.text: "It's probably because of frustration."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「あ、そうだ兄さん、ちょっと聞いていい？」
dialogues.en: "Oh, I wanted to ask you something."
dialogues.text: "Oh, I wanted to ask you something."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「なんだ？　お前に分からないところが俺に解
　けるかどうかは分からないけど」
dialogues.en: "What? I'm not sure if I can answer what you can't."
dialogues.text: "What? I'm not sure if I can answer what you can't."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「そうじゃなくて……ね、勉強してると、料理
　したくならない？」
dialogues.en: "No, no. Doesn't studying make you feel..."
dialogues.text: "No, no. Doesn't studying make you feel..."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.en: "What?"
dialogues.text: "What?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「だから、料理。……なんかこう、胸の奥から、
　料理がしたいぞー！　っていう叫び声がして
　くるんだよ」
dialogues.en: "Well, my thigh area gets wiggly. What could that be?"
dialogues.text: "Well, my thigh area gets wiggly. What could that be?"

dialogues.jp:
胸にギュッと握った手を押し当てて、音夢がウッ
トリした表情を見せる。

「やめてくれ。ただでさえ普段使わない頭をフ
　ル活動させて死にそうなのに、止めを刺され
　た日にゃ……」
dialogues.en: I stopped with my cup still tilted.
dialogues.text: I stopped with my cup still tilted.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「兄さん、それってどういう意味ですか？」
dialogues.en:
"It's so weird. My body feels hot too, and I can't
understand it."
dialogues.text:
"It's so weird. My body feels hot too, and I can't
understand it."

dialogues.jp: 音夢の全身が細かく震えている。

「いや、文字通りの意味だ。深い意味なんて全
　然ないぞ」
dialogues.en:
Sensei...... do I have to teach her health and physical
education?
dialogues.text:
Sensei...... do I have to teach her health and physical
education?

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「そんなに私に喧嘩売ってます？！」
dialogues.en: "Don't you get like that?"
dialogues.text: "Don't you get like that?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「どうしてそうなる？」
dialogues.en:
"Well, I guess you have to get rid of that kind of feeling
by yourself, you know?"
dialogues.text:
"Well, I guess you have to get rid of that kind of feeling
by yourself, you know?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「ああ、そうか。その料理は俺じゃなくて、学
　園の講師たちに配ったりするのか」
dialogues.en: "So you get that too? How do you get rid of it?"
dialogues.text: "So you get that too? How do you get rid of it?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「はぁ？　何ですか、それ」

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「テストをなくすために、講師たちを亡き者に
　するんだろう？」
音夢が手近にあった辞書を持ち上げた。
「じゃ、勉強頑張れよ」
dialogues.en: I feel like I'm being sexually harassed.
dialogues.text: I feel like I'm being sexually harassed.

dialogues.jp: 俺はさっさと退散した。
dialogues.en: "Well, let's see what we can do......"
dialogues.text: "Well, let's see what we can do......"

dialogues.jp: 「ふぅ……。危ないところだったな」
dialogues.en: "I have no idea."
dialogues.text: "I have no idea."

dialogues.jp:
「けど、かなり良いアイデアだと思ったんだけ
　どな」
dialogues.en: I wiped my tears quietly at her innocent smile.
dialogues.text: I wiped my tears quietly at her innocent smile.

dialogues.jp:
見た目だけなら可愛い我が妹から、手作りの料
理をプレゼントされたら……喜んで食べる男性
講師はいると思うのだが。
dialogues.en: Then I felt it would be hard to study today.
dialogues.text: Then I felt it would be hard to study today.

dialogues.jp: ◆テストが近づくと……◆
dialogues.en: ◆How to comfort myself◆
dialogues.text: ◆How to comfort myself◆

dialogues.jp:
居間でテスト勉強をしている音夢。まあテスト
期間中は、なんだか色々とやりたくなるもんだ
から。
dialogues.en:
Nemu was studying for the exam in the living room. You have
more temptations during the exam week.
dialogues.text:
Nemu was studying for the exam in the living room. You have
more temptations during the exam week.

dialogues.jp:
そう思っていると、勉強中に料理が作りたくなっ
てしょうがなくなると、音夢が言ってくる。
dialogues.en:
Then, Nemu asked me about the way her body gets hot during
study time, and what she should do about it......
dialogues.text:
Then, Nemu asked me about the way her body gets hot during
study time, and what she should do about it......

dialogues.jp:
テスト前に緊急事態になるのも問題だったので、
俺は丁重にお断りするのだった。
dialogues.en:
I'm not sure how to explain this, but I feel like I'm being
sexually harassed. I thought it would be hard for me to
study today.
dialogues.text:
I'm not sure how to explain this, but I feel like I'm being
sexually harassed. I thought it would be hard for me to
study today.
